sections.label: Scam cases and losses rise
sections.summary: Reported scam cases rose from 5,383 in 2016 to 9,545 in 2019, and amounts lost rose from $89.7 million to $170.8 million.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Since then, the number of scams reported has increased by 77%, from 5,383 cases in 2016 to 9,545 cases in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: There were 10,402 cases of scam reported in the first eight months of this year, which is a 100% increase over the 5,229 cases reported during the same period last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In terms of the total amount lost, it has also risen over the past years, from $89.7 million in 2016 to $170.8 million in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In the first eight months of this year, the total amount cheated increased by almost 71% to $157 million, from $92 million in the same period in 2019.

sections.label: ASC first year results
sections.summary: In its first year, the ASC froze over 6,100 bank accounts and recovered over S$21.2 million.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In its first year of operation, the ASC froze more than 6,100 bank accounts and recovered more than S$21.2 million.

sections.label: Top scam by incidents
sections.summary: The top scam by number of incidents is the e-commerce scam.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: The first question with regard to the most popular scam crimes that we have tracked, the top three, in terms of number of incidents that has happened, will be first is the e-commerce scam.

sections.label: Investment scam losses and challenges
sections.summary: Investment scams have the highest financial losses, and online scams are challenging due to their trans-borderless and anonymous nature.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: In terms of the amount, the highest levels of investment or financial losses will be for those related to investment scams.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: I do not have the data right now.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: We have to bear in mind that online scams represent a very challenging area to deal with, in terms of how we look at the trans-borderless nature of this crime, as well as how anonymous some of these crime scammers can go about doing its operation.

sections.label: Targeted public education on scams
sections.summary: Police and MHA target scam education at prone groups, working with community networks for seniors and IMDA's Seniors Go Digital Programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: The Police and MHA have started, in terms of our public education, to be more targeted and focused on specific targets that are prone to certain different kinds of scams.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: So, for the seniors group, other than the mainstream media, we also work very closely with the community networks through their events, through their house visits including the Agency for Integrated Care, to make sure that some of these messages are communicated to them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: We also work with IMDA, in terms of the Seniors Go Digital Programme, to try and see whether we can highlight, in the process of teaching them how to use the smartphone, to be more mindful of the risk and the threat that can come their way.
